_comment: Loadout for the lag repro save. tools/make_run_save.sh turns this into a
run_v3_<profile>.json the game will offer as 'Continue run'.
Continuing lands in the shop for `wave`; press Go to play it.
Six Shredder IVs: each shot pierces 3, has can_bounce = true, and carries the
weapon's own exploding_effect, so every pellet that lands is an explosion.
item_ricochet turns can_bounce into actual bounces (+1 each).
item_fruit_basket is the only fruit source that matters this deep: the normal
consumable roll is divided by (1 + endless factor), which is ~202x at wave 80,
enemy_scaling is the game's own accessibility multiplier, stored per run, and it
is the only thing here that is not a real build. At wave 80 the endless factor is
~201: EntityService multiplies enemy health by 2.25x that and damage by 1x that,
and Player divides the i-frames after a hit by it. Left at 1.0 the wave is not a
measurement, it is a death on contact against enemies nothing can kill.
So: damage 0.001 (net ~1x base, survivable) and health 0.02 (net ~9x base, so
things actually die and the kill path - explosions, loot, fruit, materials - runs).
Speed stays at 1.0. Spawn counts are untouched, which is what the frame time is
actually about. Put health back to 1.0 for the other test: nothing dies, enemies
pile up against the wave cap, and you are measuring live-entity count alone.
